description: Send one real WhatsApp text message from the workspace's WhatsApp number into one WhatsApp group, after the user confirms. Every member of that group (real people outside LetsBot) receives it, and a sent message cannot be recalled or edited. Works on a number connected to LetsBot by QR code (the number's own WhatsApp groups), and on an official green-tick Cloud API number (not Coexistence) for groups created with Meta's Groups API under Channels › WhatsApp groups — their chat_id contains letters; @mentions are not supported there. On the official Cloud API, WhatsApp does not deliver the number's existing group chats. Identify the group with "group_id", set to the group's "chat_id" from get_groups (e.g. 120363041234567890@g.us); "chat_id" is accepted as an alias. Group names are not accepted. One group per call: this is not a broadcast or bulk-messaging tool.

chat_id.description: Alias of "group_id", accepted because get_groups calls this value "chat_id". Pass the group in "group_id" OR "chat_id", not both.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to post this message into the group.

group_id.description: The group's "chat_id" exactly as returned by get_groups (e.g. 120363041234567890@g.us), for ONE group. The digits without @g.us are also accepted. Group names and the numeric "id" field are refused. This is the preferred argument.

mentions.description: Optional, WhatsApp groups on a QR-connected number only. Group members to tag (@mention) so WhatsApp highlights their name and notifies them: phone numbers in international format without + (e.g. "5511970793770") or member ids from WhatsApp (e.g. "5511970793770@s.whatsapp.net", "123456789012345@lid"). A member whose @<number> is not already in the text gets it added at the start automatically. Every @<number> already written in the text is tagged too, so this list is optional when the text names them. Max 50.

message.description: The text to post into the group. Every member of the group will see it. To tag (@mention) a member so WhatsApp notifies them, write @ followed by their full number in international format without + or spaces, e.g. "@5511970793770 please send the report" — every such @number becomes a real mention. Members can also be listed in "mentions".

name: send_group_message
